name: OMCP
author: Tyler South
description: Turn this desktop into an MCP server so Claude Code and other agents can drive it — themes, windows, workspaces, notifications, screenshots — and watch every move land live in the bar.

barWidget.description: A ghost in the bar that lights up when an agent touches your desktop, with per-tool permissions, held approvals, and a kill switch.
